title: Phone Remote Control
description: Let a phone remotely take over this machine's session (tools still run locally). Once enabled, local conversations are mirrored to the phone, and the phone can drive the same session.
unpairConfirmDesc: This phone will no longer control this computer. Scan a new code if you want to pair it again.
pairingCodeHint: Scan the QR code with the FutureOS mobile app within 5 minutes. The code can only be used once.
copyFailed: Copy failed — copy the code manually.
note: Phone control requires this computer to stay on and online.
